name: long_horizon_engineering
description: Full-Hermes long-horizon engineering benchmark with 3 primary arms and secondary structural retrieval A/B per Task 4 / Task 5 spec (§7, §8).

A.name: standard_hermes_compression
A.description: Actual default ContextCompressor with standard compression/recovery behavior.

B.name: hermes_structure_aware_clm
B.description: Native CLM plugin with autonomous compaction, Context Map snapshot, deterministic lookup, and validated restore.

C.name: full_history_baseline
C.description: Full canonical history without pruning or summarization, stopping at hard ceiling without server shift.

R_flat.name: clm_flat_retrieval
R_flat.description: Corrected CLM archive and deterministic flat lookup/status without hierarchical path scoring or visible map snapshot.

R_map.name: clm_structural_map_retrieval
R_map.description: Full CLM Context Map with hierarchy/path-aware scoring, progressive disclosure visible snapshot, and deterministic lookup.

retrieval_substudy_protocol.controls: Identical Qwen provider, source corpus, labels/descriptions/keywords, budgets, sampling, caps, and full Hermes lifecycle across R_flat and R_map.
retrieval_substudy_protocol.exposure_definitions: Verified absent-detail exposure from active raw context, summaries, visible map, and candidate metadata; target 80 decision cycles post-archive.
retrieval_substudy_protocol.scoring_denominators: Evaluated at episode and query level; unexercised, failed, and censored cases reported explicitly without averaging away invalid references.
retrieval_substudy_protocol.extension_rules: Preregister at least 6 matched delayed-recall episode pairs; bounded extension rule if fewer than 6 valid absent-detail cases emerge.
retrieval_substudy_protocol.stopping_rules: 150 task decision cycles, 450 total provider requests, or 4 hours elapsed wall time ceiling per arm.

workloads.name: State Resume Defect
workloads.description: Diagnose and fix a state/resume defect, update persistence/compatibility behavior, document migration.

workloads.name: Multi-Layer Feature Implementation
workloads.description: Implement a feature spanning an API and worker/tool layer with error handling, tests, failed-test inspection and revision.

workloads.name: Historical Regression Investigation
workloads.description: Investigate a regression requiring old logs/configuration, explicit correction of an early assumption, code fix, and explanation.
